Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::queryLoanTerm(itemid: Integer): LoanTerm {
	definition:
		loanTerm: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemid),
		linkedLoanRequest: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(lr|lr.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(loanTerm))
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		loanTerm.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		linkedLoanRequest.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(loanTerm) and
		result = loanTerm or
		loanTerm.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = null
